```{r}
# Load packages
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(countrycode)
library(ggplot2)
```
```{r}
# Read gender inequality dataset
gii2010 <- read_csv(
  "data/gender_inequality2010.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

gii2019 <- read_csv(
  "data/gender_inequality2019.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Read world spatial boundaries
world <- st_read(
  "data/World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson"
)

# Inspect the datasets
names(gii2010)
names(world)

# Check dimensions
dim(gii2010)
dim(world)

# Inspect spatial reference system
st_crs(world)
```
```{r}
# Select and rename 2010 GII values
gii_2010 <- gii2010 %>%
  select(
    countryIsoCode,
    GII_2010 = actualValue
  )

# Select and rename 2019 GII values
gii_2019 <- gii2019 %>%
  select(
    countryIsoCode,
    GII_2019 = actualValue
  )

str(gii_2010)
str(gii_2019)
```
```{r}
# Join GII datasets by ISO country code
gii_change <- gii_2010 %>%
  full_join(
    gii_2019,
    by = "countryIsoCode"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GII_change = GII_2019 - GII_2010
  )

# Inspect the result
head(gii_change)

# Check the number of countries
nrow(gii_change)

# Summary statistics
summary(gii_change$GII_change)
```
```{r}
# Convert ISO2 country codes to ISO3
world <- world %>%
  mutate(
    ISO3 = countrycode(
      ISO,
      origin = "iso2c",
      destination = "iso3c"
    )
  )

# Check converted codes
world %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(COUNTRY, ISO, ISO3) %>%
  head(10)
```
```{r}
# Find countries with missing ISO3 codes
world %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(is.na(ISO3)) %>%
  select(COUNTRY, ISO)
```
```{r}
# Join GII data to spatial boundaries
world_gii <- world %>%
  left_join(
    gii_change,
    by = c("ISO3" = "countryIsoCode")
  )

# Inspect joined data
head(world_gii)

# Check number of valid mapped features
sum(!is.na(world_gii$GII_change))
```

```{r}
# Calculate symmetric colour scale limits
max_change <- max(
  abs(world_gii$GII_change),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Create global GII change map
gii_map <- ggplot(world_gii) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = GII_change),
    colour = "grey60",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166AC",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#B2182B",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-max_change, max_change),
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "GII Change"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    crs = "+proj=robin",
    default_crs = sf::st_crs(4326)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Global Gender Inequality Change (2010–2019)",
    subtitle = "Negative values indicate improvement; positive values indicate worsening",
    caption = "Source: UNDP Human Development Reports"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      colour = "grey90",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    )
  )

print(gii_map)
```
